name: torrent-live
description: A torrent client that streams video while it downloads, and serves it to your local network. Native Apple Silicon, no Rosetta required.
author: Juan Antonio Jimenez Montes

scripts.dist: npm run ffmpeg:mac && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run ffmpeg:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run ffmpeg:linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
